sessionPairingCode: One-time pairing code (optional for an existing session)
sessionPairingHint: Use the local launcher or paste an administrator-issued one-time pairing code. Sessions last 30 minutes, renew while in use, and expire after at most 8 hours. Reloading restores the session.
sessionLogoutFailed: Server logout could not be confirmed. This page disconnected; retry logout or ask the administrator to revoke the session.
security_transport: Remote security connections require HTTPS. Check the address, port and certificate trust; loopback HTTP is allowed.
security_source: The source network, browser Origin or proxy chain is not allowed. Check the server source policy.
security_transportHint: Use 127.0.0.1 locally, or https://hostname remotely with the HTTPS listening port.
security_unconfirmed: The operation may have completed, but its audit outcome could not be saved. Check its actual result before retrying.
security_credentials: The credential is invalid, expired or revoked. Obtain a new credential from the instance owner.
security_forbidden: This credential does not permit this database or operation. Model Designer also needs separate permissions for its designer workspace.
security_scopeChanged: The published interface changed. Review its release and authorize the new release digest.
security_protocol: Client credentials and server security protocol do not match. Upgrade the client and use the correct credential type.
security_legacyVault: This database uses the old Vault format. Continuing the security upgrade will not migrate it automatically.
security_unavailable: The security service is unavailable or cannot persist its audit. Check the server diagnostics.
security_closed: The secure connection closed or timed out. Reconnect with a valid credential.
security_memoryOnly: Credentials are kept only in memory. After refreshing this page, enter them again.
appSubtitle: Connect to ModelDB Engine to browse and edit library data.
dirtyBlockedDetail: Commit or discard before switching view.
importRelationHint: Bind-only CSV columns (not in column mapping) look up existing peer rows by the match field after insert — values are not stored on the import model. Mapped columns still use PROTOCOL field equality.
importUpsertHelp: When a field is selected, import matches existing rows by that field: existing rows are updated, and only missing rows are inserted. Use stable unique fields such as id or code.
importPendingOps: {{count}} pending op(s) — use Commit in the toolbar
importStagedSummary: Staged {{rows}} rows ({{insertOps}} insert batch(es){{bindPart}}){{skippedPart}} Use Commit in the toolbar to write to the engine.
importNoRowsToImport: No rows to import after mapping and cleaning.
importAmbiguityMultipleFields: Multiple model fields match CSV column "{{column}}": {{candidates}}.
importAmbiguityUnmappedColumn: No model field matches CSV column "{{column}}" (column will be ignored).
importAmbiguityRequiredField: Required model field "{{field}}" has no CSV column mapping.
importFailureReviewHint: Review failed rows below, edit values, then retry.
importFailurePartialDetail: {{inserted}} row(s) inserted; {{failed}} still failing — edit and retry.
backupEmpty: No backup files are available for this database.
backupRestorePrompt: Enter a backup file name to restore:
backupRestoreConfirm: Restore from {{file}}? Current database files will be replaced after a safety backup is created.
backupClearConfirm: Clear all data in {{db}}? Schema stays registered and a safety backup will be created first.
backupForceResetConfirm: Force-reset {{db}}? This is a corruption-recovery backdoor and will recreate the physical database after a safety backup.
